cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Tell Me Why
cards.instruction: Get someone to reveal the motive behind a choice by offering small pieces of your own truth as bait.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. We're circling the station. I avoid my old office too. Why this route?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: My former boss catches this train.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. I told mine I'd become a novelist. What did you tell yours?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That I had a better offer.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've carried the same blank notebook past mine for a year. Are you avoiding him because there wasn't a better offer?
